description: turn.context.read: one owner-scoped snapshot. Main-lane proofs exclude the unfinished target. Version 2 uses model-context revisions unaffected by declared display-only enrichment; terminal witnesses remain storage-minted. Completed-prefix continuation never substitutes for same-turn execution recovery.
proofEncoding: SHA-256 of ordered UTF-8 compact JSON arrays [turnId,parentTurnId,storedStatus,currentAttemptId,revision], each followed by LF; nulls preserved; no ASCII escaping. Version 1 uses projectionRevision. New proofs are version 2 and use modelContextRevision = projectionRevision minus the authority-maintained count of declared display-only settled projection updates. Genuine content/tool/identity/execution edits still advance or invalidate the proof. Legacy v1 checkpoints rebuild once; their proof must not be re-labelled as v2.
terminalWitness: The authority-minted terminal witness also binds currentAttemptId and modelContextRevision when revision metadata is available; genuine terminal edits, edit/revert and attempt replacement cannot resurrect stale summaries. Display-only CAS updates preserve this revision. Native private documents derive the same value before settlement publication.
displayExclusionBoundary: Only the listed producer-owned projection locations are normalized. Protected JSON equality is type-sensitive, including boolean versus number and integer versus float. Arbitrary user/tool JSON and genuine tool content, model content, arguments, call identity, status, inbox/steering evidence and unknown fields remain protected. Projection CAS, storage revision and synchronization still advance on every display update. Translation overlays are excluded only at the declared projection and text/thinking segment roots, never recursively in tool arguments/results. Translation that replaces content remains a semantic edit. These lists generate both Python and Rust consumers.
pagination: nextTurnId is the last complete returned Turn; send it as after_turn_id for the next owner-scoped page. The prefix proof, covered count, and continuation must remain identical across pages; callers discard and retry on mismatch. A single Turn exceeding the page budget fails loudly rather than truncating its model-visible tool history.
eligibility: Main lane; no fresh-plan prefix restoration; text-only checkpoint without attachment references or opaque native media. Prefix restoration excludes same-turn recovery. Successful Continue may publish a fresh completed prefix only after atomic resume hydration and when the final model message exactly represents the delivered projection; unverified/unrepresented recovery stays cold. Ineligible requests rebuild; edits, deletion, reordering and policy mismatch cannot reuse a prefix.
